description: This file defines a React component 'ExploreGap' that displays details about gaps between roles, fetching data via API calls, rendering a table with gap analysis, and providing options to export or save profiles.

methods.name: proficiencyLabel
methods.description: Converts a numeric proficiency level to a label ('F', 'P', 'A', 'Au').

methods.name: onSaveAsProfile
methods.description: Handles saving the current gap analysis as a user profile via API calls.

methods.name: onExportSnapshot
methods.description: Handles exporting the current view, currently by invoking window.print().
